definitions.explanation: A mature bell pepper that has ripened to a red color, sweeter than green bell peppers.

examples.japanese: サラダに{赤|あか}ピーマンを{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I added red bell pepper to the salad.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ピーマンは{緑|みどり}のピーマンより{甘|あま}い。
examples.english: Red bell peppers are sweeter than green ones.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ピーマンと{黄|き}ピーマンを{細切|ほそぎ}りにして{彩|いろど}りよく{炒|いた}めた。
examples.english: I sliced the red and yellow bell peppers thinly and stir-fried them for a colorful dish.

notes:
Composed of {赤|あか} (red) and ピーマン (bell pepper, from French "piment"). In Japanese supermarkets, the standard green ピーマン is the most common and cheapest variety, while {赤|あか}ピーマン and {黄|き}ピーマン (yellow bell pepper) are often sold at a premium. Note that パプリカ (paprika) refers to the larger, thicker-walled colored bell peppers, while {赤|あか}ピーマン can refer to either a regular-sized red pepper or a paprika.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {赤|あか}ピーマンの{千切|せんぎ}り — julienned red bell pepper
- {赤|あか}ピーマンを{炒|いた}める — to stir-fry red bell pepper
- {赤|あか}ピーマンの{肉詰|にくづ}め — stuffed red bell pepper

RELATED WORDS:
- ピーマン — bell pepper (usually the green variety)
- パプリカ — paprika; large colored bell pepper
- {唐辛子|とうがらし} — chili pepper (spicy, not to be confused with bell pepper)
